verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.pt: Depois disse o Senhor a Moisés:
verses.en_web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Moses,

verses.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come into the land of your habitations, which I give unto you,
verses.pt: Fala aos filhos de Israel e díze-lhes: Quando entrardes na terra da vossa habitação, que eu vos hei de dar,
verses.en_web: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you have come into the land of your habitations, which I give to you,
verses.en_bbe: Say to the children of Israel, When you have come into the land which I am giving to you for your resting-place,

verses.en: And will make an offering by fire unto the LORD, a burnt offering, or a sacrifice in performing a vow, or in a freewill offering, or in your solemn feasts, to make a sweet savour unto the LORD, of the herd, or of the flock:
verses.pt: e ao Senhor fizerdes, do gado eu do rebanho, oferta queimada, holocausto ou sacrifício, para cumprir um voto, ou como oferta voluntária, para fazer nas vossos festas fixas um cheiro suave ao Senhor,
verses.en_web: and will make an offering by fire to Yahweh, a burnt offering, or a sacrifice, to accomplish a vow, or as a freewill offering, or in your set feasts, to make a pleasant aroma to Yahweh, of the herd, or of the flock;
verses.en_bbe: And are going to make an offering by fire to the Lord, a burned offering or an offering in connection with an oath, or an offering freely given, or at your regular feasts, an offering for a sweet smell to the Lord, from the herd or the flock:

verses.en: Then shall he that offereth his offering unto the LORD bring a meat offering of a tenth deal of flour mingled with the fourth part of an hin of oil.
verses.pt: Então aquele que fizer a sua oferta, fará ao Senhor uma oferta de cereais de um décimo de efa de flor de farinha, misturada com a quarta parte de um him de azeite;
verses.en_web: then he who offers his offering shall offer to Yahweh a meal offering of one tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with the fourth part of a hin of oil.
verses.en_bbe: Then let him who is making his offering, give to the Lord a meal offering of a tenth part of a measure of the best meal mixed with a fourth part of a hin of oil:

verses.en: And the fourth part of an hin of wine for a drink offering shalt thou prepare with the burnt offering or sacrifice, for one lamb.
verses.pt: e de vinho para a oferta de libação prepararás a quarta parte de um him para o holocausto, ou para o sacrifício, para cada cordeiro;
verses.en_web: You shall prepare wine for the drink offering, the fourth part of a hin, with the burnt offering, or for the sacrifice, for each lamb.
verses.en_bbe: And for the drink offering, you are to give with the burned offering or other offering, the fourth part of a hin of wine for every lamb.

verses.en: Or for a ram, thou shalt prepare for a meat offering two tenth deals of flour mingled with the third part of an hin of oil.
verses.pt: e para cada carneiro prepararás como oferta de cereais, dois décimos de efa de flor de farinha, misturada com a terça parte de um him de azeite;
verses.en_web: “‘Or for a ram, you shall prepare for a meal offering two tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with the third part of a hin of oil;
verses.en_bbe: Or for a male sheep, give as a meal offering two tenth parts of a measure of the best meal mixed with a third part of a hin of oil:

verses.en: And for a drink offering thou shalt offer the third part of an hin of wine, for a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.pt: e de vinho para a oferta de libação oferecerás a terça parte de um him em cheiro suave ao Senhor.
verses.en_web: and for the drink offering you shall offer the third part of a hin of wine, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: And for the drink offering give a third part of a hin of wine, for a sweet smell to the Lord.

verses.en: And when thou preparest a bullock for a burnt offering, or for a sacrifice in performing a vow, or peace offerings unto the LORD:
verses.pt: Também, quando preparares novilho para holocausto ou sacrifício, para cumprir um voto, ou um sacrifício de ofertas pacíficas ao Senhor,
verses.en_web: When you prepare a bull for a burnt offering, or for a sacrifice, to accomplish a vow, or for peace offerings to Yahweh;
verses.en_bbe: And when you make ready a young ox for a burned or other offering, or for the effecting of an oath, or for peace-offerings to the Lord:

verses.en: Then shall he bring with a bullock a meat offering of three tenth deals of flour mingled with half an hin of oil.
verses.pt: com o novilho oferecerás uma oferta de cereais de três décimos de efa, de flor de farinha, misturada com a metade de um him de azeite;
verses.en_web: then shall he offer with the bull a meal offering of three tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with half a hin of oil:
verses.en_bbe: Then with the ox give a meal offering of three tenth parts of a measure of the best meal mixed with half a hin of oil.

verses.en: And thou shalt bring for a drink offering half an hin of wine, for an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.pt: e de vinho para a oferta de libação oferecerás a metade de um him como oferta queimada em cheiro suave ao Senhor.
verses.en_web: and you shall offer for the drink offering half a hin of wine, for an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: And for the drink offering: give half a hin of wine, for an offering made by fire for a sweet smell to the Lord.

verses.en: Thus shall it be done for one bullock, or for one ram, or for a lamb, or a kid.
verses.pt: Assim se fará com cada novilho, ou carneiro, ou com cada um dos cordeiros ou dos cabritos.
verses.en_web: Thus shall it be done for each bull, or for each ram, or for each of the male lambs, or of the young goats.
verses.en_bbe: This is to be done for every young ox and for every male sheep or he-lamb or young goat.

verses.en: According to the number that ye shall prepare, so shall ye do to every one according to their number.
verses.pt: Segundo o número que oferecerdes, assim fareis com cada um deles.
verses.en_web: According to the number that you shall prepare, so you shall do to everyone according to their number.
verses.en_bbe: Whatever number you make ready, so you are to do for every one.

verses.en: All that are born of the country shall do these things after this manner, in offering an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.pt: Todo natural assim fará estas coisas, ao oferecer oferta queimada em cheiro suave ao Senhor.
verses.en_web: “‘All who are native-born shall do these things in this way, in offering an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: All those who are Israelites by birth are to do these things in this way, when giving an offering made by fire of a sweet smell to the Lord.

verses.en: And if a stranger sojourn with you, or whosoever be among you in your generations, and will offer an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD; as ye do, so he shall do.
verses.pt: Também se peregrinar convosco algum estrangeiro, ou quem quer que estiver entre vos nas vossas gerações, e ele oferecer uma oferta queimada de cheiro suave ao Senhor, como vós fizerdes, assim fará ele.
verses.en_web: If a stranger lives as a foreigner with you, or whoever may be among you throughout your generations, and will offer an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh; as you do, so he shall do.
verses.en_bbe: And if a man from another country or any other person living among you, through all your generations, has the desire to give an offering made by fire of a sweet smell to the Lord, let him do as you do.

verses.en: One ordinance shall be both for you of the congregation, and also for the stranger that sojourneth with you, an ordinance for ever in your generations: as ye are, so shall the stranger be before the LORD.
verses.pt: Quanto à assembléia, haverá um mesmo estatuto para vós e para o estrangeiro que peregrinar convosco, estatuto perpétuo nas vossas gerações; como vós, assim será o peregrino perante o Senhor.
verses.en_web: For the assembly, there shall be one statute for you and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner, a statute forever throughout your generations. As you are, so shall the foreigner be before Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: There is to be one law for you and for the man of another country living with you, one law for ever from generation to generation; as you are, so is he to be before the Lord.

verses.en: One law and one manner shall be for you, and for the stranger that sojourneth with you.
verses.pt: Uma mesma lei e uma mesma ordenança haverá para vós e para o estrangeiro que peregrinar convosco.
verses.en_web: One law and one ordinance shall be for you, and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner with you.’”
verses.en_bbe: The law and the rule are to be the same for you and for those from other lands living with you.

verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.pt: Disse mais o Senhor a Moisés:
verses.en_web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Moses,

verses.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land whither I bring you,
verses.pt: Fala aos filhos de Israel, e dize-lhes: Depois de terdes entrado na terra em que vos hei de introduzir,
verses.en_web: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you come into the land where I bring you,
verses.en_bbe: Say to the children of Israel, When you come into the land where I am guiding you,

verses.en: Then it shall be, that, when ye eat of the bread of the land, ye shall offer up an heave offering unto the LORD.
verses.pt: será que, ao comerdes do pão da terra, oferecereis ao Senhor uma oferta alçada.
verses.en_web: then it shall be that when you eat of the bread of the land, you shall offer up a wave offering to Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: Then, when you take for your food the produce of the land, you are to give an offering lifted up before the Lord.

verses.en: Ye shall offer up a cake of the first of your dough for an heave offering: as ye do the heave offering of the threshingfloor, so shall ye heave it.
verses.pt: Das primícias da vossa massa oferecereis um bolo em oferta alçada; como a oferta alçada da eira, assim o oferecereis.
verses.en_web: Of the first of your dough you shall offer up a cake for a wave offering. As the wave offering of the threshing floor, so you shall heave it.
verses.en_bbe: Of the first of your rough meal you are to give a cake for a lifted offering, lifting it up before the Lord as the offering of the grain-floor is lifted up.

verses.en: Of the first of your dough ye shall give unto the LORD an heave offering in your generations.
verses.pt: Das primícias das vossas massas dareis ao Senhor oferta alçada durante as vossas gerações.
verses.en_web: Of the first of your dough, you shall give to Yahweh a wave offering throughout your generations.
verses.en_bbe: From generation to generation you are to give to the Lord a lifted offering from the first of your rough meal.

verses.en: And if ye have erred, and not observed all these commandments, which the LORD hath spoken unto Moses,
verses.pt: Igualmente, quando vierdes a errar, e não observardes todos esses mandamentos, que o Senhor tem falado a Moisés,
verses.en_web: “‘When you err, and don’t observe all these commandments, which Yahweh has spoken to Moses,
verses.en_bbe: And if in error you go against any of these laws which the Lord has given to Moses,

verses.en: Even all that the LORD hath commanded you by the hand of Moses, from the day that the LORD commanded Moses, and henceforward among your generations;
verses.pt: sim, tudo quanto o Senhor vos tem ordenado por intermédio do Moisés, desde o dia em que o Senhor começou a dar os seus mandamentos, e daí em diante pelas vossas gerações,
verses.en_web: even all that Yahweh has commanded you by Moses, from the day that Yahweh gave commandment, and onward throughout your generations;
verses.en_bbe: All the laws which the Lord has given you by the hand of Moses, from the day when the Lord gave them, and ever after from generation to generation;

verses.en: Then it shall be, if ought be committed by ignorance without the knowledge of the congregation, that all the congregation shall offer one young bullock for a burnt offering, for a sweet savour unto the LORD, with his meat offering, and his drink offering, according to the manner, and one kid of the goats for a sin offering.
verses.pt: será que, quando se fizer alguma coisa sem querer, e isso for encoberto aos olhos da congregação, toda a congregação oferecerá um novilho para holocausto em cheiro suave ao Senhor, juntamente com a oferta de cereais do mesmo e a sua oferta de libação, segundo a ordenança, e um bode como sacrifício pelo pecado.
verses.en_web: then it shall be, if it was done unwittingly, without the knowledge of the congregation, that all the congregation shall offer one young bull for a burnt offering, for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh, with its meal offering, and its drink offering, according to the ordinance, and one male goat for a sin offering.
verses.en_bbe: Then, if the wrong is done in error, without the knowledge of the meeting of the people, let all the meeting give a young ox as a burned offering, a sweet smell to the Lord, with its meal offering and its drink offering, as is ordered in the law, together with a he-goat for a sin-offering.

verses.en: And the priest shall make an atonement for all the congregation of the children of Israel, and it shall be forgiven them; for it is ignorance: and they shall bring their offering, a sacrifice made by fire unto the LORD, and their sin offering before the LORD, for their ignorance:
verses.pt: E o sacerdote fará expiação por toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel, e eles serão perdoados; porquanto foi erro, e trouxeram a sua oferta, oferta queimada ao Senhor, e o seu sacrifício pelo pecado perante o Senhor, por causa do seu erro.
verses.en_web: The priest shall make atonement for all the congregation of the children of Israel, and they shall be forgiven; for it was an error, and they have brought their offering, an offering made by fire to Yahweh, and their sin offering before Yahweh, for their error.
verses.en_bbe: So the priest will make the people free from sin, and they will have forgiveness; for it was an error, and they have given their offering made by fire to the Lord, and their sin-offering before the Lord, on account of their error:

verses.en: And it shall be forgiven all the congregation of the children of Israel, and the stranger that sojourneth among them; seeing all the people were in ignorance.
verses.pt: Será, pois, perdoada toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel, bem como o estrangeiro que peregrinar entre eles; porquanto sem querer errou o povo todo.
verses.en_web: All the congregation of the children of Israel shall be forgiven, as well as the stranger who lives as a foreigner among them; for with regard to all the people, it was done unwittingly.
verses.en_bbe: And all the meeting of the children of Israel, as well as those from other lands living among them, will have forgiveness; for it was an error on the part of the people.

verses.en: And if any soul sin through ignorance, then he shall bring a she goat of the first year for a sin offering.
verses.pt: E, se uma só pessoa pecar sem querer, oferecerá uma cabra de um ano como sacrifício pelo pecado.
verses.en_web: “‘If one person sins unwittingly, then he shall offer a female goat a year old for a sin offering.
verses.en_bbe: And if one person does wrong, without being conscious of it, then let him give a she-goat of the first year for a sin-offering.

verses.en: And the priest shall make an atonement for the soul that sinneth ignorantly, when he sinneth by ignorance before the LORD, to make an atonement for him; and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.pt: E o sacerdote fará perante o Senhor expiação pela alma que peca, quando pecar sem querer; e, feita a expiação por ela, será perdoada.
verses.en_web: The priest shall make atonement for the soul who errs, when he sins unwittingly before Yahweh, to make atonement for him; and he shall be forgiven.
verses.en_bbe: And the priest will take away the sin of the person who has done wrong, if the wrong was done unconsciously, and he will have forgiveness.

verses.en: Ye shall have one law for him that sinneth through ignorance, both for him that is born among the children of Israel, and for the stranger that sojourneth among them.
verses.pt: Haverá uma mesma lei para aquele que pecar sem querer, tanto para o natural entre os filhos de Israel, como para o estrangeiro que peregrinar entre eles.
verses.en_web: You shall have one law for him who does anything unwittingly, for him who is native-born among the children of Israel, and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner among them.
verses.en_bbe: The law in connection with wrong done unconsciously is to be the same for him who is an Israelite by birth and for the man from another country who is living among them.

verses.en: But the soul that doeth ought presumptuously, whether he be born in the land, or a stranger, the same reproacheth the LORD; and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
verses.pt: Mas a pessoa que fizer alguma coisa temerariamente, quer seja natural, quer estrangeira, blasfema ao Senhor; tal pessoa será extirpada do meio do seu povo,
verses.en_web: “‘But the soul who does anything with a high hand, whether he is native-born or a foreigner, the same blasphemes Yahweh. That soul shall be cut off from among his people.
verses.en_bbe: But the person who does wrong in the pride of his heart, if he is one of you or of another nation by birth, is acting without respect for the Lord, and will be cut off from his people.

verses.en: Because he hath despised the word of the LORD, and hath broken his commandment, that soul shall utterly be cut off; his iniquity shall be upon him.
verses.pt: por haver desprezado a palavra do Senhor, e quebrado o seu mandamento; essa alma certamente será extirpada, e sobre ela recairá a sua iniqüidade.
verses.en_web: Because he has despised Yahweh’s word, and has broken his commandment, that soul shall utterly be cut off. His iniquity shall be on him.’”
verses.en_bbe: Because he had no respect for the word of the Lord, and did not keep his law, that man will be cut off without mercy and his sin will be on him.

verses.en: And while the children of Israel were in the wilderness, they found a man that gathered sticks upon the sabbath day.
verses.pt: Estando, pois, os filhos de Israel no deserto, acharam um homem apanhando lenha no dia de sábado.
verses.en_web: While the children of Israel were in the wilderness, they found a man gathering sticks on the Sabbath day.
verses.en_bbe: Now while the children of Israel were in the waste land, they saw a man who was getting sticks on the Sabbath day.

verses.en: And they that found him gathering sticks brought him unto Moses and Aaron, and unto all the congregation.
verses.pt: E os que o acharam apanhando lenha trouxeram-no a Moisés e a Arão, e a toda a congregação.
verses.en_web: Those who found him gathering sticks brought him to Moses and Aaron, and to all the congregation.
verses.en_bbe: And those who saw him getting sticks took him before Moses and Aaron and all the people.

verses.en: And they put him in ward, because it was not declared what should be done to him.
verses.pt: E o meteram em prisão, porquanto ainda não estava declarado o que se lhe devia fazer.
verses.en_web: They put him in custody, because it had not been declared what should be done to him.
verses.en_bbe: And they had him shut up, because they had no directions about what was to be done with him.

verses.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, The man shall be surely put to death: all the congregation shall stone him with stones without the camp.
verses.pt: Então disse o Senhor a Moisés: certamente será morto o homem; toda a congregação o apedrejará fora do arraial.
verses.en_web: Yahweh said to Moses, “The man shall surely be put to death. All the congregation shall stone him with stones outside of the camp.”
verses.en_bbe: Then the Lord said to Moses, Certainly the man is to be put to death: let him be stoned by all the people outside the tent-circle.

verses.en: And all the congregation brought him without the camp, and stoned him with stones, and he died; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.pt: Levaram-no, pois, para fora do arraial, e o apedrejaram, de modo que ele morreu; como o Senhor ordenara a Moisés.
verses.en_web: All the congregation brought him outside of the camp, and stoned him to death with stones, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
verses.en_bbe: So all the people took him outside the tent-circle and he was stoned to death there, as the Lord gave orders to Moses.

verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.pt: Disse mais o Senhor a Moisés:
verses.en_web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Moses,

verses.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and bid them that they make them fringes in the borders of their garments throughout their generations, and that they put upon the fringe of the borders a ribband of blue:
verses.pt: Fala aos filhos de Israel, e dize-lhes que façam para si franjas nas bordas das suas vestes, pelas suas gerações; e que ponham nas franjas das bordas um cordão azul.
verses.en_web: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them that they should make themselves fringes in the borders of their garments throughout their generations, and that they put on the fringe of each border a cord of blue:
verses.en_bbe: Say to the children of Israel that through all their generations they are to put on the edges of their robes an ornament of twisted threads, and in every ornament a blue cord;

verses.en: And it shall be unto you for a fringe, that ye may look upon it, and remember all the commandments of the LORD, and do them; and that ye seek not after your own heart and your own eyes, after which ye use to go a whoring:
verses.pt: Tê-lo-eis nas franjas, para que o vejais, e vos lembreis de todos os mandamentos do Senhor, e os observeis; e para que não vos deixeis arrastar à infidelidade pelo vosso coração ou pela vossa vista, como antes o fazíeis;
verses.en_web: and it shall be to you for a fringe, that you may look on it, and remember all Yahweh’s commandments, and do them; and that you don’ t follow your own heart and your own eyes, after which you use to play the prostitute;
verses.en_bbe: So that, looking on these ornaments, you may keep in mind the orders of the Lord and do them; and not be guided by the desires of your hearts and eyes, through which you have been untrue to me:

verses.en: That ye may remember, and do all my commandments, and be holy unto your God.
verses.pt: para que vos lembreis de todos os meus mandamentos, e os observeis, e sejais santos para com o vosso Deus.
verses.en_web: so that you may remember and do all my commandments, and be holy to your God.
verses.en_bbe: And that you may keep in mind all my orders and do them and be holy to your God.

verses.en: I am the LORD your God, which brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am the LORD your God.
verses.pt: Eu sou o senhor vosso Deus, que vos tirei da terra do Egito para ser o vosso Deus. Eu sou o Senhor vosso Deus.
verses.en_web: I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am Yahweh your God.”
verses.en_bbe: I am the Lord your God, who took you out of the land of Egypt, so that I might be your God: I am the Lord your God.
